metadata.title: my-agents
metadata.description: Frontend console for private chats and shared knowledge bases

home.title: An AI workspace that answers from your documents.
home.description: Add documents, ask questions, and check the citations that show where each answer came from.
featureCards: Add PDFs, Markdown, text notes, Excel workbooks, or PowerPoint decks to a knowledge space.
Ask in the central chat and let the AI use the knowledge you choose.
Open citations beside answers to verify the supporting passages.
transcriptRows: You: What are the renewal risks in this contract?
AI: I found the relevant clauses and summarized them.
activityItems: Add documents to a knowledge space
home.citationText: Answers keep supporting passages close so you can verify them quickly.
home.sourceText: Organize uploaded files and notes into spaces that the AI can reference.

auth.heroDescription: Sign in to add knowledge, ask questions, and verify answers with citations.
features: Upload or write sources into a knowledge space.
Ask follow-up questions from the same workspace.
Review citations without leaving the answer.
auth.signupDescription: Create an account, verify your email, then start building your AI workspace.
auth.loginDescription: Log in and continue asking questions from your knowledge.
auth.signupSuccessDescription: We created {email}. Check your inbox for the verification link, then log in with this account.
auth.signupPendingApprovalDescription: We created {email}. After operator approval, a verification email will be sent.
auth.guestDescription: Enter an email to request a demo code. Guest sessions last 24 hours and have limited chats, prompts, and uploads.
auth.guestEmailHint: If approved, the operator will send a guest access code to this address.
auth.guestRequestReceivedDescription: We received the request for {email}. If approved, a guest code will be sent to that inbox.
auth.guestCodeDescription: Redeem the code from your email to start the limited demo session.
auth.guestCodeHint: Codes are one-time use and expire automatically.
auth.emailVerificationWorkingDescription: Please wait while we confirm your verification link.
auth.emailVerificationSuccessDescription: Your account is verified. You can now log in and open the service console.
auth.emailVerificationFailedDescription: The verification link may be expired or already used. Try signing up again or request a new verification email later.
auth.emailVerificationMissingDescription: Open the full verification link from your email, including the token query parameter.
auth.passwordResetDescription: Enter a new password to complete the reset flow.
auth.passwordResetMissingDescription: Open the full password reset link from your email, including the token query parameter.
auth.passwordResetSuccessDescription: Your password has been updated. Log in with the new password.
auth.groupInvitationWorkingDescription: We are checking this invitation for the signed-in account.
auth.groupInvitationSuccessDescription: You can now open Teams and use shared knowledge according to your role. Your conversations and memory remain private.
auth.groupInvitationFailedDescription: Sign in with the invited email address, then open the invitation link again. Expired or cancelled invitations cannot be used.
auth.groupInvitationMissingDescription: Open the full invitation link from your email, including the token query parameter.

service.sessionRestored: Ready to ask from your knowledge.
sessionEvidenceItems: Add sources, then ask in chat.
Team sharing is available when needed.

onboarding.guestPromptTitle: See how the guest demo works
onboarding.guestPromptBody: Take a short tour of limits, asking, source selection, and citations before you use the demo.
onboarding.newUserPromptBody: Learn where to add knowledge, ask questions, and verify answers.
onboarding.targetFallback: This item is not visible on the current screen, so this step is shown without a highlight.

steps.guestLimitsBody: Guest sessions are temporary and limited, so use them to try the core flow before creating a full account.
steps.guestAskBody: Type a focused question here. Accepted guest prompts count toward the demo limit.
steps.guestSourcesBody: Use this selector to decide whether the answer can reference all available knowledge or selected spaces only.
steps.guestAddSourcesTitle: Add sources when you need evidence
steps.guestAddSourcesBody: Open Add sources to upload a small number of documents for the demo. Upload limits are enforced automatically.
steps.guestEvidenceBody: When an answer uses knowledge, citations and work history appear here so you can verify what supported it.
steps.newKnowledgeSpaceBody: Create a personal knowledge space first. It gives your sources a clear home before you ask questions from them.
steps.newSourceDestinationBody: Add sources into a writable knowledge space. Team destinations use the same visible workflow when you have permission.
steps.newUploadSourceBody: Use this area for PDF, Markdown, plain-text, Excel (.xlsx), or PowerPoint (.pptx) files. You can also add text sources from the form above it.
steps.newChatThreadBody: Start a new Ask thread when you are ready to question your knowledge. Threads keep questions and answers together.
steps.newSelectKnowledgeTitle: Pick the knowledge for the answer
steps.newSelectKnowledgeBody: Use the selector to ask from all available knowledge or only the spaces you choose.
steps.newAskQuestionBody: Write the question here. The answer appears in the transcript and can stream as the run progresses.
steps.newReviewEvidenceBody: When an answer uses your knowledge, citations and safe work history stay attached beside the answer for review.

chat.title: Ask
chat.description: Ask questions and keep cited sources beside each answer.
chat.noConversationsDescription: Create a question thread to begin.
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete "{title}"? This removes the conversation and all messages. This cannot be undone.
chat.deleteConversationActiveRunDisabled: Stop the active answer before deleting this conversation.
chat.selectOrCreateConversation: Select or create a question thread
chat.noActiveConversationDescription: Create a thread to unlock the composer.
chat.streamingComposerPlaceholder: Type a follow-up — it will send after this answer.
chat.queuedComposerPlaceholder: Edit or cancel the queued follow-up before adding another.
chat.sendNowHelper: Enter queues your follow-up. Send now stops the current answer first, then sends this message.
chat.sendNowWaitingForRun: Waiting for the active answer before it can be stopped.
chat.sendNowQueuedBlocked: Edit or cancel the queued message before sending a different message now.
chat.queuedHelper: Will send after the current answer finishes.
chat.queuedAfterFailureHelper: The current answer failed. Send this queued message manually, edit it, or cancel it.
chat.guestPromptLimitHelper: Guest demo limits are enforced automatically; queued and immediate messages still count when accepted.
chat.queuedAnnouncement: Message queued to send after the current answer.
chat.queueEditAnnouncement: Queued message moved back to the composer.
chat.queueAlreadyExistsAnnouncement: A queued message already exists. Edit or cancel it first.
chat.stoppingCurrentAnswerAnnouncement: Stopping the current answer before sending your message.
chat.currentAnswerStoppingAnnouncement: Stop request accepted. Waiting for the current answer to close.
chat.immediateFailedAnnouncement: Could not stop the current answer. Your message was restored to the composer.
chat.noRunsDescription: Send a message to create the first run.
chat.noEventsDescription: Latest run events will appear here.
chat.noCitationsDescription: Citations appear here when the answer uses added knowledge.
chat.messageEvidenceUnavailable: Sources and work history attach to the latest answer.
chat.guestNoticeDescription: This guest session lasts 24 hours and is limited to one chat, 5 prompts, and 3 document uploads. If you hit a limit, a safe error appears here.
chat.knowledgeSourceDescription: Choose which authorized knowledge spaces the AI may reference. Team knowledge is selected the same way as personal knowledge.
chat.noKnowledgeBasesDescription: Create a knowledge space, add sources, then select it here.
chat.knowledgeSourceRequired: Select at least one knowledge space or switch back to All knowledge.
chat.replaySuccess: Regenerated. The conversation was refreshed with the replay result.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailable: Regenerated using current knowledge only. Some sources from the original answer are no longer available.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailableAnnouncement: Assistant message regenerated with unavailable original sources omitted.
chat.replayFailed: Could not regenerate this assistant message.
chat.replayFailedAnnouncement: Assistant message regeneration failed. Conversation state was refreshed.
chat.replayConflict: Only the latest assistant message can be regenerated right now.
chat.replayConflictAnnouncement: This assistant message cannot be regenerated because it is not the latest replayable answer.
chat.answerContextAllSources: All available knowledge could be used
chat.answerContextSelectedSources: Only selected knowledge spaces were used
chat.answerContextNoAddedKnowledge: No added knowledge was needed for this answer
chat.activeRunStale: This answer appears interrupted. Checking run status…
chat.activeRunStaleHelper: This answer may have been interrupted. We are checking its status now; if it fails, you can retry or send your queued message.
chat.knowledgeSourceBoundaryCopy: This thread stays private. Selected personal, shared, and team knowledge are used only as sources for this answer.

common.emptyListDescription: Create one from the form above.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Create spaces for the documents and notes your AI can search. Add sources, organize them, then ask questions from Ask.
knowledge.scopeHint: Personal spaces stay private to your account. Team spaces are shared libraries for selected teams after sharing is approved.
knowledge.groupHint: Required for extra team spaces. Only teams where you are owner/admin are listed.
knowledge.groupDisabledHint: Choose team scope to select an existing team.
knowledge.noGroupsDescription: Create a team or ask a team owner/admin before creating another team space.
knowledge.scopeBoundaryNote: New teams automatically get one default team knowledge space. Add documents to personal spaces first; sharing with a team requires owner/admin approval and does not share member conversations or private additions.
knowledge.listPersonalSubtitle: Personal knowledge · private to your account
knowledge.listGroupSubtitle: Team knowledge · available to selected team members
journeySteps: Create a personal or team knowledge space.
Ask questions and inspect citations in Ask.

documents.title: Add sources
documents.description: Add files or text notes to a knowledge space. Once prepared, Ask can answer from these sources and show citations.
documents.contentHint: Text is prepared for search so answers can cite the relevant passages.
documents.permissionLabel: User ID for direct read access
documents.permissionHint: Advanced control for direct sharing. User search can be added later.
documents.noExtractionRunsDescription: Processing details appear after a source is prepared.
documents.pdfUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), or PowerPoint deck (.pptx) into the selected private knowledge base. Legacy .xls/.ppt files are not supported.
documents.deleteDescription: Remove the selected source. This cannot be undone.
documents.fileUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), or PowerPoint deck (.pptx) into the selected knowledge space.
documents.multiFileUploadHint: Select one or more PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), or PowerPoint deck (.pptx) files. Each file is limited to {maxSize}.
documents.dropTitle: Drag files here or choose files below
documents.dropDescription: Dropped files are checked locally, added to the queue, then uploaded and prepared when you start processing.
documents.unsupportedFileError: Unsupported file type. Choose PDF, Markdown, plain text, .xlsx, or .pptx.
documents.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Maximum size is {maxSize}.
documents.filesAddedAnnouncement: {count} files added to the upload queue.
documents.uploadRemovedAnnouncement: File removed from the upload queue.
documents.guestUploadLimitHint: Guest demo uploads are limited automatically; each accepted file counts toward the 3-source upload cap.
documents.knowledgeBaseHint: Choose where this source should become available. Team uploads are staged privately, then sent for team sharing approval.
documents.stagingKnowledgeBaseHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then create a team approval request. The source becomes retrievable only after a team owner/admin approves the group copy.
documents.teamUploadAutoApproveHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then auto-approve it because your role can manage this team. The approved group copy becomes the retrievable source.
documents.teamUploadApprovalHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then create a team approval request. The source becomes retrievable only after a team owner/admin approves the group copy.
documents.noTeamDescription: Create or join a team before adding sources to team knowledge.
documents.noTeamKnowledgeBaseDescription: Create a team knowledge space in Knowledge, or ask a team owner/admin to create one.
documents.teamUploadRequestedAnnouncement: {file} was sent for team knowledge approval.
documents.teamTextApprovedAnnouncement: Text source was added to team knowledge.
documents.teamTextRequestedAnnouncement: Text source was sent for team knowledge approval.
documents.knowledgeBaseRequired: Select a personal knowledge space before adding or preparing sources.
documents.noKnowledgeBaseDescription: Go to Knowledge and create a personal space before adding sources. Team spaces receive sources through approved sharing.
documents.knowledgeBaseLockedHint: Finish or remove queued uploads before switching spaces so each file stays attached to the intended library.

groups.title: Teams
groups.description: Teams are invite-accepted spaces for shared knowledge. Invite people by email and review requests to share personal knowledge with the team.
groups.noSelectedDescription: Create or select a team first.
groups.patchMemberLabel: Active member user ID for role update
groups.membershipManagerOnlyHint: Only team owners and admins can invite people or change active member roles.
groups.publishBoundaryDescription: Members can ask to share a personal knowledge space with this team, or copy one document into a team knowledge space. Owners and admins approve what becomes available.
groups.publishSourceDocumentHint: Use this to copy one document into a selected group knowledge base.
groups.publishTargetKnowledgeBaseHint: Only document-copy requests need a target group knowledge base. Whole knowledge-base requests attach to the group itself.
groups.publishReviewHint: Owner/admin-only approval or rejection; no auto-publish.
groups.publishOpenApiNote: Share requests support both whole private knowledge-base approval and single-document copy approval. Pending or rejected requests do not change group knowledge.
groups.publishSourceKnowledgeBaseHint: Approval shares this whole personal knowledge space with the team. Future sources added and prepared there become team sources.
groups.memberIdNote: New access starts with email invitation acceptance. Active member role updates by user ID are advanced controls and never create members.
groups.inviteEmailHint: The response does not reveal whether this email already has an account.
groups.noInvitationsDescription: Invite a teammate by email. Membership starts only after they accept while signed in.
groups.noMembersDescription: Owners and admins can review accepted members here after invitations are accepted.
groups.invitationActionHint: Use the invitation ID from the list. These actions never reveal account existence.
groups.patchMemberHint: Only use this for already-accepted members. It cannot create membership.

errors.csrfMissing: Session proof is missing. Please sign in again.
errors.legacyChatBlocked: Legacy assistant chat is not available in the product
